dedupe_keys.name: opencpn chart plotter and navigation software

description: OpenCPN (Chart-Plotter Navigation) is free chart plotter and GPS navigation software for use on boats, developed by a team of active sailors who test it underway. Coverage: worldwide use with S-57 and encrypted S-63 vector charts displayed to the IHO S-52 standard, up-to-date electronic navigational charts for selected regions distributed through o-charts.org, Inland ECDIS version 2.3 support, AIS input with target tracking and collision alerts, SART handling, GRIB and GRIB2 weather files, tide and current prediction, an NMEA dashboard and multiplexer, GPX import and export of waypoints, tracks and routes, and more than 45 plugins including weather routing. The current release at the time read was version 5.14.2. Format and access: downloadable desktop software with a plugin catalogue. Licence and cost: free; the project's licensing file states GPLv2 or later for its own files, with some bundled code under other licences. Caveats: a navigation aid built by volunteers, not a type-approved ECDIS. It can be used as a GIS environment to view inland ENCs, replay AIS tracks and check routes produced by waterway network flow or vessel traffic simulations. It relates to the Inland Electronic Navigational Charts and the German federal waterways Inland ENC in the catalogue.
